title: Alan dışı geri verme, kural katmanı: alan_disi / ALAN_ISTEGI satırını okuyan ve genişlet / beklet / reddet kararını veren saf kütüphane
roadmap_row: Repairs and improves itself (How it is built from here: the team cycle)
goal: Proposal team/proposals/2026-10-02-alan-disi-geri-verme.md, rules (1) and (2), as PURE functions in a NEW file scripts/lib/TeamArea.ps1 (PowerShell 5.1, dot-sources scripts/lib/TeamQueue.ps1 and reuses Get-TeamProperty, Set-TeamProperty, Get-TeamAreaKey, Test-TeamAreasOverlap, Test-TeamPathInsideArea, Get-TeamTimestamp; it starts no process, reads no file, writes no store). scripts/team/cycle.ps1, scripts/lib/TeamQueue.ps1, scripts/lib/TeamRun.ps1, scripts/tests/team-cycle.tests.ps1 and scripts/tests/lib/fake-claude.ps1 are three other cards' area: this card does NOT touch them and does NOT wire anything into the cycle - the wiring is a later card that calls these functions. CONTRACT (identical in card area-widen-role-lines): the request is ONE line of a role's report, alone on its line, case-sensitive key, a bracketed comma-separated list of repository-relative paths with forward slashes: the inspector writes `alan_disi: [path, path]` (above its RETURN verdict line), the worker writes `ALAN_ISTEGI: [path, path]`; backticks, asterisks and surrounding spaces around the line or a path are ignored, the LAST such line of the report wins, an empty list or a line without brackets is 'no request'. Functions: (a) Get-TeamAreaRequest -Report <text> -Role inspector|worker -> Asked (bool), Files (normalised: forward slashes, no leading ./, duplicates removed, order kept), Bad (entries dropped because they are absolute, carry a drive letter or '..'); the inspector key is not read from a worker's report nor the reverse. (b) Resolve-TeamAreaRequest -Task -Queue -Files -> Decision 'widen' | 'wait' | 'refuse', Add (the files not already inside the task's area), DependsOn (ids), Why (a Turkish sentence for the report). Order of judgement: nothing asked that is outside the area -> 'refuse' (nothing to widen); ANY asked path protected -> 'refuse' whole, nothing partial; the task already widened twice (area_widenings >= 2, the cap is a named constant) -> 'refuse', to the lead; the area after adding would exceed 25 entries -> 'refuse'; ANY asked path overlaps (Test-TeamAreasOverlap, both directions, file inside directory) the area of ANOTHER task whose state is approved, assigned, in_progress, inspecting or returned -> 'wait' with DependsOn = those tasks' ids, the area unchanged; otherwise 'widen'. Protected, never widened into: the shared files of TeamQueue.ps1 ($script:TeamSharedFiles: docs/HANDOFF.md, docs/DECISIONS.md, state/BUILD_STATE.json, docs/THIRD_PARTY_COMPONENTS.md, team/queue.json, team/lock.json) and any directory holding one; docs/ROADMAP.md; docs/TEAM_PROTOCOL.md; .claude/agents; anything matching hand-gestures; secrets, last-known-good metadata and the recovery roots - the worker finds the real paths of these three in the repository (PROJECT_CONSTITUTION.md, docs/DEVELOPMENT_POLICY.md, the recovery supervisor's tree, .gitignore) and names each with its source in the ADR; the list is one constant in TeamArea.ps1. (c) Add-TeamAreaWidening -Task -Resolution -By <role> -Why <text> -Now -> on 'widen': appends Add to the task's area, increments area_widenings, appends to area_history one record {at, by, why, files}; on 'wait': adds DependsOn to the task's depends_on (no duplicate, never the task's own id) and appends an area_history record with waits_for; on 'refuse': changes nothing. Running it twice with the same resolution changes nothing the second time. (d) Test-TeamAreaReturnCounts -Resolution -> $false for 'widen' and 'wait' (the return is the card's fault, not the worker's: it is not one of the two rights), $true for 'refuse'. Register the suite as its own step in scripts/quality-gate.ps1 next to 'Agent team roadmap feeder' (same shape: PS 5.1, Assert-ExitCode). One ADR in team/plans/area-widen-rules-adr.md (the lead numbers it and writes docs/DECISIONS.md): the contract line, the judgement order, the protected list with sources, the cap, why 'wait' never widens partially, and that the queue schema fields area_history / area_widenings reach the store only with the wiring card.
acceptance: scripts/tests/team-area.tests.ps1 runs green under Windows PowerShell 5.1 (powershell -NoProfile -File) and as a step of scripts/quality-gate.ps1; written RED first (the report shows the red run before TeamArea.ps1 existed). It proves, each with its own named case: (1) parsing - an inspector report with `alan_disi: [services/api/app/voice/intents.py, services/api/app/gateway/x.py]` above `RETURN (...)` gives both paths; the same line wrapped in backticks or bold; back-slashed paths normalised; the last line wins; an empty list, a missing bracket, the key in prose ('alan_disi listesi yok') give Asked = false; '../x', '/x', 'C:/x' land in Bad and never in Files; a worker report's ALAN_ISTEGI is not read as the inspector's and the reverse. (2) no conflict -> 'widen': the area gains exactly the missing files, a file already inside a directory of the area is not added again, area_widenings becomes 1, area_history holds who / why / which files, Test-TeamAreaReturnCounts is false. (3) conflict -> 'wait': a requested file inside the directory area of another task in each of the five in-work states gives DependsOn = that id, the area is unchanged; the same file held only by a task that is merged, awaiting_release, released, done or stopped does NOT conflict; a directory request holding another task's file conflicts too. (4) protected -> 'refuse': every entry of the protected constant, one case each, including a directory that holds a shared file (docs, state, team) and a request that mixes one protected path with one free path (nothing is widened); a test reads the text of scripts/lib/TeamQueue.ps1 and asserts every entry of its $script:TeamSharedFiles is refused, so the two lists cannot drift. (5) the cap: the third widening of one task is 'refuse' and Test-TeamAreaReturnCounts is true; a 26-entry result is 'refuse'. (6) idempotence: Add-TeamAreaWidening twice with the same resolution leaves area, depends_on, area_widenings and area_history equal to the first result. (7) the two real cases of d20261001 as fixtures: narrative-failures-only-model asking for services/api/app/voice/intents.py with no holder -> 'widen'; the same request while a card holding services/api/app/voice/intents.py is approved -> 'wait' on that card. Mutation RED with sha256 restore from a backup copy, three separate mutations, each turning at least one named case red: the protected check removed, the conflict check removed, the cap removed. No file outside the area is changed; the existing team-cycle and team-feed suites still pass unchanged.
evidence_expected: PROVEN_AUTOMATED: the new suite's raw counts under PS 5.1, the red-first run, the three mutation REDs with restore hashes, the gate step listed and green. Nothing is wired into the cycle by this card, so nothing here is PROVEN_PROXY or READY_FOR_OWNER; PROVEN_REAL belongs to the later wiring card's first real cycle (the two stopped tasks reopened and merged).

title: Alan dışı geri verme, rol metinleri: denetleyici alan_disi satırını, çalışan kırmızı testten sonra ALAN_ISTEGI satırını yazar; rol metni ile ayrıştırıcı birbirini okur
roadmap_row: Repairs and improves itself (How it is built from here: the team cycle)
goal: Proposal team/proposals/2026-10-02-alan-disi-geri-verme.md, the role half of rules (1) and (3). CONTRACT (identical in card area-widen-rules, whose parser Get-TeamAreaRequest in scripts/lib/TeamArea.ps1 is on main when this card starts): the request is ONE line of a role's report, alone on its line, case-sensitive key, a bracketed comma-separated list of repository-relative paths with forward slashes: the inspector writes `alan_disi: [path, path]` (above its RETURN verdict line), the worker writes `ALAN_ISTEGI: [path, path]`; backticks, asterisks and surrounding spaces are ignored, the LAST such line wins, an empty list or a line without brackets is 'no request'. Change two role files and nothing else of the product: (a) .claude/agents/inspector.md - when an item of a RETURN can only be fixed in a file outside the card's area, the report carries the `alan_disi: [...]` line with exactly those files, on its own line ABOVE the verdict; the verdict stays the last line and stays `RETURN (list)` (the 'your LAST message is all the cycle reads' paragraph and the verdict grammar are not weakened); a finding is never softened into an area request - a real defect inside the area is listed as before and counts; the line names files, never a protected path as a wish (secrets, LKG, recovery roots, ROADMAP, TEAM_PROTOCOL, the lead's shared files): for those the inspector writes the finding and the lead decides. (b) .claude/agents/worker.md - after the red acceptance test is written and committed, if turning it green needs a file outside the area, the worker does NOT implement and does NOT touch that file: it returns at once with the `ALAN_ISTEGI: [...]` line, the red test's name and the one sentence of why; 'touches files outside its assigned area: never' stays as it is. Both texts say only what the report must carry; neither promises what the cycle does with it (the cycle's wiring is a later card - until it lands the lead reads the line and widens by hand). Add to scripts/tests/team-area.tests.ps1 (the suite of area-widen-rules, already a gate step - do not edit scripts/quality-gate.ps1) a section that READS the two role files from disk: the example line each role file shows is extracted from the file's own text and fed to Get-TeamAreaRequest for that role, and must come back Asked = true with the example's paths - so the role text and the parser cannot drift. One ADR in team/plans/area-widen-role-lines-adr.md (the lead numbers it): why the worker's request comes after the red test and before any implementation, and what the lead does with the line until the wiring exists.
acceptance: Red first: the new section of scripts/tests/team-area.tests.ps1 fails against the unchanged role files (the report shows that run), then passes. It proves: (1) inspector.md contains the key `alan_disi:` with a bracketed example, and that exact example line, taken from the file by the test, parses with -Role inspector to its paths; (2) worker.md contains `ALAN_ISTEGI:` with a bracketed example that parses with -Role worker; (3) inspector.md still ends its report rule with exactly one verdict `APPROVE` | `RETURN (list)` | `REJECT (reason)` and a report built as the role file describes (the alan_disi line, then `RETURN (...)` as the last line) gives Get-TeamVerdict = RETURN with the list as Detail AND Get-TeamAreaRequest = the files - the two readers do not disturb each other; (4) worker.md still carries the sentence that a worker never touches a file outside its area. Mutation RED with sha256 restore from a backup copy: the key renamed in inspector.md (e.g. `alan-disi:`) turns case 1 red; the brackets removed from the worker example turns case 2 red. The whole team-area suite, team-cycle.tests.ps1 (it copies .claude/agents/*.md into its scratch repository) and team-feed.tests.ps1 pass under PS 5.1 with raw counts in the report. Only the four files of the area are changed; the frontmatter of both role files (name, description, tools) is byte-identical.
evidence_expected: PROVEN_AUTOMATED: the red-first run, the suite's raw counts, the two mutation REDs with restore hashes, team-cycle and team-feed unchanged and green. A role text is proven only as far as its contract with the parser; whether a real inspector and a real worker write the line is seen in the next real cycles' reports (the lead counts it there) - not claimed by this card.
